desc: Golfer's Flat Cap: a classic brown tweed flat cap with a short stiff brim, the kind old golfers wear
Tartan Tam: a floppy red-and-green tartan tam o'shanter golf cap with a big fluffy red pom-pom on top, worn tilted
Clubhouse Panama: a wide cream straw panama hat with a dark green and gold striped club band
Golf Ball Helmet: a hat shaped like a giant white dimpled golf ball sitting on the head, a little red tee sticking out of the top
Hole in One: a tiny round putting green worn as a hat, neat bright grass with a little hole, a white golf ball rolling to it and a red flag on a thin flagstick standing up from it
Argyle Sweater Vest: a knitted golf sweater vest in green, cream and burgundy argyle diamonds over a white collared shirt
Caddie's Bib: a white caddie's bib with a big green number 19 on the chest, worn over a striped shirt, a little towel tucked in the strap
Norfolk Jacket: an old-fashioned belted brown tweed golf jacket with patch pockets and a cream shirt and knitted tie
Loud Windbreaker: a shiny golf windbreaker in a loud clashing pattern of orange, teal and purple zigzags, zipped up to the chin
Champion's Jacket: a deep green tailored champion's blazer with gold buttons, a gold embroidered club crest on the pocket, a crisp white shirt and a gold tie
Trusty Putter: a golf putter with a silver blade head and a worn black grip, held upright

Lucky Ball: a small white dimpled golf ball on a little red tee floating beside the ogre's head like the examples float, a faint golden lucky shimmer round it. Soft painted look exactly like the examples, no outlines
Big Driver: a golf driver with a big round polished wooden head and a long shaft, resting on the shoulder
Golf Bag: a big leather golf bag slung over one shoulder by its strap, several club heads with knitted covers sticking out of the top

Course Gopher: a SMALL round brown gopher dozing with its eyes closed, hugging a stolen white golf ball, perched on the ogre's shoulder like the frog and the parrot. Soft painted look exactly like the examples, no outlines
Club Champion's Cup: a big shiny two-handled golden trophy cup with a little golfer on the lid, held up high
